name: Jar wine
summary: Bahnar and Jrai jar wine, also called rượu ghè when the festival list uses that name. You drink it from the jar. Two Bahnar makers in Đak Pơ print different jar prices in the same article.
origin: The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism’s Tết-goods article, for Nhâm Dần 2022, follows Bahnar wine in làng Hven, thị trấn Đak Pơ, and a Jrai formula in Ia Piar, Phú Thiện. The 2020 Gia Lai food-festival note calls the same drink rượu ghè.
howToEat: Drink it from the jar. A strength is Check on arrival.
Đinh Thị Pldới’s Bahnar wine uses hạt cào cào and a leaf yeast. She told the article that a jar ran 400,000–700,000 VND because the plant is hard to grow.
Đinh Thị Chới, in the same village, ferments with rainwater. Her Tết jars that year were quoted from 250,000 to 700,000 VND.
Nay H’Lơm’s Jrai jars use leaf and root yeast with rice, corn, cassava, millet, rice husk, and charcoal, for family rites rather than the shop.
VnExpress, 29 May 2016, sets a jar beside the bamboo-skewer beef in Pleiku.
where: Làng Hven in Đak Pơ, Ia Piar in Phú Thiện, and the Pleiku table in the 2016 article. An hour is Check on arrival.
priceBand: The Tết article prints 400,000–700,000 VND a jar for hạt cào cào wine and 250,000–700,000 VND a jar for the rainwater wine. A Pleiku glass is Check on arrival.
